description.p: TrueStream is a modern, privacy-respecting media extractor powered by an embedded yt-dlp engine. It allows users to download video and audio streams in full fidelity from over 1,000 supported platforms with zero advertising SDKs and zero telemetry.

ul.li: Up to 4K/8K 60fps video downloads and Opus/AAC high-bitrate extraction
Hardware-optimized local processing with embedded runtimes
Playlist batch downloads with selective ordering and shuffling

description.p: Initial beta release of TrueStream with embedded yt-dlp core.
